Class OrderDao

java.lang.Object
sakaboba.dao.OrderDao
public class OrderDao extends Object
Order persistence. createOrder writes the order and its lines in one transaction.

  • Method Details

    • createOrder

      public OrderReceipt createOrder(int employeeId, List<OrderLine> lines, PaymentMethod paymentMethod)
      Saves a completed order for the employee. The total comes from menuitem.price, never from the caller, and repeated menu items are merged because orderitem is unique per (order, item).
      Parameters:
      employeeId - ID of the employee taking the order
      lines - cart lines; must not be empty
      paymentMethod - how the customer paid
      Returns:
      the new order's ID and total
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the employee, payment method or lines are invalid
      DataAccessException - if an item or employee no longer exists or the write fails

    • findToday

      public List<OrderSummary> findToday()
      Today's orders, newest first, including voided and returned ones so they stay visible.
      Returns:
      summaries of orders created since local midnight
      Throws:
      DataAccessException - if the database cannot be read

    • voidOrder

      public void voidOrder(int orderId)
      Marks a completed order as voided. The order and its lines are kept for reporting.
      Parameters:
      orderId - ID of the order to void
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if no order is selected
      DataAccessException - if the order is not completed or the update fails

    • returnOrder

      public void returnOrder(int orderId)

      Parameters:

      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if no order is selected
      DataAccessException - if the order is not completed or the update fails

      private void changeStatus(int orderId, OrderStatus target)

      private static int insertOrder(Connection connection, int employeeId, BigDecimal total, PaymentMethod paymentMethod) throws SQLException

      Returns the next unused ID for a table, which has no identity sequence.
